data class Verdict(val verdict: String, val divergences: List<String>)

fun plan(pr: String): Verdict {
    val repoContext = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/README.md")
    val repoIndex = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/index.md")
    val maintenance = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/maintenance.md")
    val generatedIndex = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
    val engineering = readSpec(path = ".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
    val metadata = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val diff = readDiff(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
    val mmDocs = search(path = "_mm/socratic", pattern = "*.adoc")
    val decisions = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/adrs/yuanrong-datasystem-adr-001-master-worker-split.adoc")
    val backendDecision = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/adrs/yuanrong-datasystem-adr-002-pluggable-cluster-metadata.adoc")
    val hashDecision = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/adrs/yuanrong-datasystem-adr-003-consistent-hash-ring-placement.adoc")
    val reliabilityDecision = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/adrs/yuanrong-datasystem-adr-004-performance-first-optional-reliability.adoc")
    val arc42 = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/arc42/arc42-yuanrong-datasystem.adoc")
    val prd = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/prd-yuanrong-datasystem.adoc")
    val useCases = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/docs/specs/use-cases-yuanrong-datasystem.adoc")
    val openQuestions = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/OPEN_QUESTIONS-yuanrong-datasystem.adoc")
    val questionTree = readSpec(path = "_mm/socratic/QUESTION_TREE-yuanrong-datasystem.adoc")
    val codebaseMap = readSpec(path = "_mm/legion-map/CODEBASE.md")
    val cliKb = readFile(path = "_mm/vibed-codeset/.claude/docs/knowledge.json")
    val cliCommand = readFile(path = "cli/command.py")
    val setup = readFile(path = "setup.py")
    val touchedFile = readFile(path = "cli/disk_report.py")
    val findings = analyze(diff, listOf(decisions, backendDecision, hashDecision, reliabilityDecision, arc42, prd, useCases, openQuestions, questionTree, codebaseMap, cliKb, cliCommand, setup, touchedFile))
    val verdict = makeVerdict(findings)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = verdict)
    return verdict
}
